test_cases.what_to_try: On the main screen press "Allow Access" and see where you land; come straight back with the phone's Back without switching anything. Then press the round black button at the lower right, and in the box press GO TO SET; see where you land, and come back with Back.

test_cases.what_happened: I pressed 'Allow Access' on the main page. It took a moment, and then a grey page appeared with the large heading 'All files access', the app's name, and a switch marked 'Allow access to manage all files', which was off. I did not touch the switch. I pressed the phone's Back and was on the main page again. Then I pressed the round black button at the lower right. A white box rose up with the heading 'Request permission to access all files' and one black button, 'GO TO SET'. I pressed it, and after a pause I was on the very same 'All files access' page, the same heading and the same switch. Back took me straight to the main page. So both buttons took me to exactly the same page, with a clear heading, and I got back easily both times. I could see afterwards that they were the same step. Beforehand, 'Allow Access' told me what it would do and 'GO TO SET' did not; the heading of the white box, about permission to access files, is what let me guess. It worked out better than I feared, but the two different wordings are still a stumble for me.
